description: What a career break costs: pay given up, pension contributions missed, and what those contributions would have grown to by retirement. Use for 'what does a year off cost my pension'.

monthlyPensionContribution.description: Pension going in each month, employer's included.

monthlyTakeHome.description: Take-home pay given up each month. Defaults to 0.

monthsOff.description: Length of the break in months.

yearsToRetirement.description: Years from the break to retirement.

name: calculate_career_break
title: Career break cost
